_schema.name: OSHIN Public CCTV Indonesia · Provenance Registry
_schema.note: A public portal, asserted verified_live, or HLS MIME header is NOT proof that every camera is live, embeddable, or redistributable. No auto-play/proxy without operator rights; coordinates are camera-level only.
_schema.priority_note: P0 prioritization for DKI, Malang Raya (Kota Malang verified portal only), Surabaya and tolls. No OSHIN per-camera live verification or retransmission permission.
_schema.research_expansion_note: New official-source findings as of 2026-10-19: 12 portals (including 1 kabupaten), 17 Pontianak operator-published YouTube watch URLs (historical links, not currently verified live). All additions METADATA_ONLY; no camera pins, no restream, no leaked feeds.

sources.research_observation: Portal hidup (© 2025, 50+ kamera diklaim). Halaman /streaming memuat kamera via JavaScript — URL .m3u8 TIDAK terlihat di HTML statis. Butuh headless browser untuk ekstrak.
Diblok robots.txt dari server riset. ~40 titik rawan macet nasional (Nagreg dll). Cek ulang via browser lokal.

CCTV resmi Merapi + YouTube live. Beberapa titik visual puncak. Pola URL perlu diprobe.

sources.operator: Badan Pengatur Jalan Tol (BPJT), Kemen PU
sources.research_observation: Official BPJT toll CCTV portal enumerates road corridors. Its FAQ states public real-time viewing is available; CCTV archive/history is restricted, and no third-party republishing rights have been established.
Official Bina Marga catalog has eight linked corridor pages with camera labels; website online counts are operator-side claims, not independently verified OSHIN playback.

sources.operator: Jakarta Smart City / Diskominfotik DKI (CCTV Bali Tower)
sources.research_observation: Portal hidup (Okt 2026) TAPI peta CCTV publik & endpoint API JSON terbuka tidak lagi tampil — portal kini berorientasi super-app JAKI. API ~2000 kamera era lama kemungkinan ditutup/butuh auth. JANGAN diandalkan tanpa konfirmasi ulang.
TIDAK ADA endpoint web publik. Hanya via app Travoy. Dicatat untuk kelengkapan — JANGAN masukkan ke rencana sebagai sumber API.
Domain ini 404. Cirebon mungkin pindah domain (atcs-dishub / sub-path lain). Perlu cari ulang.
Official Jakarta CCTV Publik page lists camera sites at Gatot Subroto, Thamrin, Tanah Abang, Senayan and Gerbang Pemuda; individual playback and embedding rights not verified by OSHIN.

sources.operator: Pemerintah Kota Bogor · Bogor Single Window
sources.research_observation: Official portal lists many public CCTV locations; individual camera streams not independently tested
Official site advertises 50+ ATCS cameras; number is an operator claim, not an enumerated or playback-verified count
Official site publishes camera names and explicitly forbids downloading or capturing its live video; OSHIN must not mirror/record/rebroadcast
Dishub FAQ publicly directs residents to live CCTV portal; individual feed formats and replay permissions unverified
Official restreamer landing page labels several channels LIVE; playback/network probes not executed
Mentioned by user supplied security report as public by design; feed and online counts not independently verified
Official-public-stream context mentioned in user supplied threat report; unverified allegation of a breach does not imply compromise of the public portal
Official Kota Malang site has public 'Stream Camera' view and locality search. Individual media and coordinates not verified. Kota Batu and Kabupaten Malang remain research gaps.

sources.operator: Dinas Perhubungan Kota Surabaya · SITS CCTV
sources.research_observation: Pemkot reports >1,000 SITS traffic monitoring cameras, not >1,000 publicly embeddable feeds. Official Dishub SITS CCTV app provides traffic viewing; no public third-party API or streaming rights verified.

sources.operator: Ditjen Bina Marga · Jalan Nasional Non-Tol
sources.research_observation: Official non-toll highway CCTV catalog supplements toll coverage and must not be misclassified as a toll-road source.

sources.operator: Pemerintah Kota Banda Aceh · CCTV Kota
sources.research_observation: Official city site indexed 56 cameras with 43 ONLINE and 13 OFFLINE as publisher-side status at crawl; not independently checked per feed, nor authorized for embedding. CCTV listed by kecamatan.

Official portal indexes numbered public cameras (Tugu Keris Siginjai, Simpang BI, Persijam, Mayang, Puncak, Kota Baru). Count 22 is a minimum of list entries visible in search, not total camera network.
City public CCTV map claims 30 online and names traffic/public areas (Simpang BOM Baru, Bandara, Veteran, Masjid Agung, Benteng Kuto Besak). No OSHIN player/stream verification.

WARNING: GeoPortal landing advertises 70/88 total points and 41 HLS online while map /cctv exposed 0 active in text crawl. Treat counts as inconsistent, NOT live-verified. Do not ingest location, address, population/other restricted layers.
Official portal says 35 cameras and names Simpang Mentari, Hasan Basri, Pasar Lama, Lambung Mangkurat and others. 'LIVE' is portal label, not confirmed by OSHIN.
Official ATCS Kota Banjar shows public live streaming category, named junction views (Jembar, Alun-alun, Parungsari, Gardu). Not the same city as Banjarmasin or Banjarbaru.

Official Samarinda City page lists eight public viewing points and says its feeds are displayed through YouTube; users are directed to SAMAGOV app for per-camera selection. YouTube license and embedding eligibility not verified.
Official Banjarbaru map shows numerous markers and a Pantauan CCTV entry. Individual map coordinates, health and media remain unverified.

sources.operator: Dishub Kota Pontianak · CCTV YouTube Resmi
sources.research_observation: Pontianak government article (16 Nov 2025) explicitly published official YouTube channel and direct public view links for camera intersections. The article confirms deliberate publication, but individual videos may no longer be live in Oct 2026. No HLS extraction, video capture or mirroring.

cameras.label: Jalan Ahmad Yani depan Gedung DPRD Provinsi

sources.research_observation: Official department describes a mobile application that provides selected road CCTV views. This page is product documentation, not a public HLS/JSON feed. Access to closed backend must not be inferred.

sources.operator: Diskominfo Kota Kendari · Satu Data CCTV
sources.research_observation: Kendari Satu Data publicly lists 'Data CCTV Kota Kendari' (2026-07-07), a downloadable municipal camera inventory. No live stream is evidenced. Dataset may have location metadata; no unverified coordinates imported.

Dishub portal advertises 3 ATCS intersections/12 cameras (Simpang Irama, Baharu, Pasar Limbur) and marks feeds LIVE. Portal labels not independently checked in OSHIN and no redistribution rights established.
